title: ze_peach_insanity_n64
description:
What ? You didn't earn the cake last time ? You beat 5 stages of a CS2 adaptation and you didn't get the reward of the original game with 19+ stages ???

Well... Here we go ! We didn't find princess Peach, but we haven't search the basement yet... Maybe if we find all red coins again, and collect all the stars to open this secret door in the basement, Peach will be behind, waiting for us with her delicious cake... who knows ?

_ 4 main levels
_ 1 secret level
_ admin room (same place than before)
_ custom level voting system (thanks to the big manly man ShadoW for his HUGE help) play what you want when you want
_ the map is designed like a video game's main quest : keep progressing and unlock its secrets
_ Each level has its own originality
_ selfmade sprites and particles
_ HD textures ripped off directly from nintendo
_ selfmade models (except for the ones available on the models-ressource.com). Thanks to Kaesar for his Bowser's animations
_ Thanks to Easter for his overlays (screen text, health bar and underwater <3)

This is the second part of my Mario 64 project, where i want to remade the original game with high accuracy, but adapted to CS2 gameplay. Have fun, and see you later for the final part...

This map is my second submission to the S2ZE mapping contest 2025 Return to roots ! Please have fun and give me feedback for every problem you may encounter.
